remarks: Nestled perfectly between Rochester and Buffalo, this exceptional 10-acre property offers the ultimate self-sufficient lifestyle, blending peaceful country living with easy access to city necessities and shopping. For the homesteader or hobby farmer, the land is a turnkey dream, featuring a fully equipped barn with horse stalls, chicken coop, two additional equipment sheds, and double driveways for easy trailer access. The expansive acreage provides space for livestock, rotational grazing, or sprawling gardens, complemented by a detached 2.5-car garage with a dedicated workshop for projects and loft for additional storage.  This sprawling 5 bedroom, 3 full bath farmhouse is designed to handle both large-family living and the demands of a working homestead. A massive, recently remodeled eat-in kitchen with Corian countertops offers abundant storage, while a spacious first-floor mudroom and laundry room keep dirty farm gear contained. Living spaces flow effortlessly from the formal dining room into a sun-drenched family room with vaulted ceilings, skylights, and an attached sunroom. Outside, composite decks, an above-ground pool, and a concrete patio look out over the enormous yard, creating the perfect oasis to relax after a long day.  Back on the market after buyer financing fell through.  Septic has passed inspection and property is ready for a quick close!  OPEN HOUSE Sunday 10/25 1-3 pm.
